name: Crimson Lake
source:
After years of isolation, Lily Grim returns to her childhood home with no purpose – only to uncover the secrets left in its ashes. 

Follow her lead to discover the family's hidden truths, explore the house, and help young Lily break free from her past – or let it consume her!
